name: Milya
source:
Katerina's childhood and best friend. She is simple-minded, but also is very sharp. You could say that she overall is "Ultra Super in Her Pace". Unlike Katerina, she can make a mizuame. Almost inseparable with Katerina and always support she, even in hardest times. Hates canned herring.

[spoiler]After capture by Japan likes to go to the Headquarters sweets shops.[/spoiler]

"I'm always with you, Katerinochka..."
